title: Excellent
content: I have been very impressed with this practise recently.  The reception staff are so friendly and helpful and the clinician I saw was very thorough and very helpful.  I have used ' LIVI' through this practise a few times and that has been very good.  It's so good to finally have a doctor's surgery where it's not impossible to get an appointment
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
